asset_heavy.reason: Owns hot-mix asphalt plants, aggregate facilities, liquid asphalt terminals and paving equipment fleets requiring ongoing capital investment.

big_ticket.reason: Highway, runway and road construction projects are large, infrequent contracts for agencies and developers.

cyclical_demand.reason: Mostly public road, highway and airport work funded by state and federal agencies; maintenance and resurfacing are essential and stable.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are state and federal agencies, municipalities, airports and military installations, plus private developers.

notes: Products are asphalt and aggregates, mostly used in its own projects. Some are sold externally.

offers_products.reason: Sells hot-mix asphalt and aggregates to external customers, though much is used internally; materials are a named offering.

offers_services.reason: Main business is constructing, paving, milling, repairing and maintaining roads, highways, runways and commercial sites.

people_delivered.reason: Paving revenue depends on plants, materials and heavy equipment, not just staff time; it is vertically integrated construction.

recurring_revenue.reason: Revenue comes from project-based paving and construction contracts, though agencies reward repeat work; mostly one-off projects.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Buyers are public agencies, developers and commercial property owners, not households.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Serves state and federal agencies, municipalities, school districts, military installations, airports and private developers.
